body.name: attaining four-type law and assay coupling
body.construction: Given a feasible \((u,v,\theta)\), assign masses \((p_{00},p_{01},p_{10},p_{11})=(1-p_0-b,b,b-\Delta,p_1-b)\) at \(b=b_{\theta}(u,v)\). Conditional on \(Y_a\), generate \(W_a\) with \(P(W_a=1\mid Y_a)=u+(v-u)Y_a\), and randomize \(A\) independently.
